feed.title: Graal Development Kit for Micronaut
feed.subtitle: The Graal Development Kit for Micronaut (GDK) is a build of a curated set of Micronaut framework modules and their required libraries for building portable cloud-native microservices that take full advantage of powerful cloud platform services and that can be compiled ahead-of-time by GraalVM Native Image. The GDK also provides project creation utilities for application development and deployment.
